recommendation: Keep the source fix. It removes a misleading actor inversion from an active overview page and no further FHIR core change is recommended for FHIR-21285.
issue_request: FHIR-21285 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that omitted-payload subscription re-query behavior be made visible outside a REST-hook-specific example, with the re-query parameter aligned to the _since versus _lastUpdated decision.
initial_application: No seed-tagged git commit was found. The issue was applied through the R5 topic-based Subscription redesign: FHIR-23738 listed FHIR-21285 as covered by the empty-payload section, and git history shows Subscription notes gaining empty-payload re-query prose that FHIR-22099 later updated from _since to _lastUpdated.
additional_context: The current Subscription resource notes already tell subscribers receiving an empty notification to query based on the SubscriptionTopic and filters, optionally with _lastUpdated. The linked Zulip discussion and FHIR-22099 support leaving _lastUpdated in place. The active exchange hierarchy also includes source/exchanging-subscription.html, where the pull-notification overview still reversed the actor by saying the data source subsequently queries.
reconciliation: Updated source/exchanging-subscription.html to say the data consumer subsequently queries the data source to retrieve the data, and retained the explanation that the data source applies normal authorization, audit, permission, and consent mechanisms. No edit was made to source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml because it already satisfies the core guidance.
source_changes: source/exchanging-subscription.html: corrected the pull-notification paragraph so the data consumer queries the data source for omitted-payload notifications.

related_jiras.note: The R5 topic-based Subscription redesign explicitly listed FHIR-21285 as covered by the new empty-payload section.
Resolved the _since versus _lastUpdated question by deciding Subscription search guidance should use _lastUpdated.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue asking that omitted-payload subscription re-query behavior be made more visible and aligned with the _since versus _lastUpdated outcome.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that clients receiving no resource content still need clear general guidance to re-query for relevant resources.

evidence_items.summary: The current empty-payload section tells subscribers to query the server based on SubscriptionTopic and filters and optionally include _lastUpdated.
evidence_items.learned: The main Subscription resource guidance already implements the Jira request and should not be duplicated or rewritten.

evidence_items.summary: The active exchange overview page describes pull-style subscription notifications; before this commit it incorrectly said the data source subsequently queried.
evidence_items.learned: Because the page is active in the Exchange hierarchy and reverses the actor for the re-query flow, a targeted source correction was necessary.

evidence_items.summary: Git history shows empty-payload re-query prose added during Subscription documentation updates and later changed from _since to _lastUpdated for FHIR-22099.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-21285 was applied through the redesign stream and later kept consistent with the search-parameter decision.

evidence_items.summary: The thread discusses the Subscription example, distinguishes _since from search parameters, and records that FHIR-22099 would replace remaining Subscription _since usage before R5.
evidence_items.learned: No community evidence contradicts the current _lastUpdated wording; it supports preserving it.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record a 12-0-0 motion to merge the Argonaut Subscription changes under FHIR-23738.
evidence_items.learned: This supports treating the R5 Subscription redesign as the work-group-approved application context for FHIR-21285.
